entries.d827e2914da10373: The company states a policy of providing high-quality contact lenses at affordable prices, and that it aims to expand its business scale by acquiring, through M&A, businesses that can make use of its strengths in WEB marketing, quality control and sales capabilities. Specifically, it cites expanding sales and the number of stores handling the “Shinshia S” series introduced in ophthalmic clinic and contact lens mass-retail channels; measures to expand the drugstore channel; improving creditworthiness with customers and end consumers; hedging exchange rate fluctuation risk within the scope of actual demand; and promoting business diversification through M&A and other means.
